mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_weekly_score ( week_start_date, emp_no, emp_name, region_supervisor_id, region_supervisor_name, total_score, room_check_count, photo_count, natural_week_flag, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{weekStartDate}, #{empNo}, #{empName}, #{regionSupervisorId}, #{regionSupervisorName}, #{totalScore}, #{roomCheckCount}, #{photoCount}, #{naturalWeekFlag}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE cps_weekly_score SET emp_name = #{empName}, region_supervisor_id = #{regionSupervisorId}, region_supervisor_name = #{regionSupervisorName}, total_score = #{totalScore}, room_check_count = #{roomCheckCount}, photo_count = #{photoCount}, natural_week_flag = #{naturalWeekFlag}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cps_weekly_score_line WHERE weekly_score_id = #{weeklyScoreId} ORDER BY id ASC
